card.name: Drug interaction section headings (Effect of X on Y)
card.fires_on: The word 'Affect' (after 'A') or 'on' inside section 7 headings about drug interactions, such as 'Potential for Other Drugs to Affect' or 'Effect of X on Other Drugs'.

modes.label: Affect in heading
modes.description: The 'ffect' piece of 'Affect' in headings like 'Drugs Affecting' or 'Other Drugs to Affect'.
modes.example: 7.2 Potential for Other Drugs to A<<ffect>> VOCABRIA Cabotegravir

modes.label: on in Effect of X on
modes.description: The word 'on' in headings 'Effect of [drug] on Other Drugs'.
modes.example: 7.1 Effect of VYLEESI<< on>> Other Drugs VYLEESI may slow

card.writes: It points toward the reciprocal 'vice versa' or 'mutual' wording of two-way drug interaction headings.
card.plain: It marks the headings in the drug interactions section that say one drug affects another.
